messages:
anya: Quick sync — cutting release branch in ~2h. Need to confirm docs cutover plan + SDK regen window. Will do a canary deploy of console docs and run smoke probes. Who can own the SDK snippet regen and the changelog bump?

kevin: I can take SDK regen. Planning to run the regen job at +30m after branch cut so we don't clobber staging. I'll queue up the PRs.

sasha: I'll handle docs cutover and the canary. Can we run the canary against the new static assets bucket first? I want to validate redirects and search indexing.

maria: Heads up — the devex smoke tests will need the new snippet IDs. Kevin, can you add a short mapping file so tests don't fail in CI?

kevin: Yep, will push a mapping JSON at the same time. Example command I'll run:```bash
tools/sdk-docs-regen --models=all --output=site/snippets --dry-run=false
git checkout -b regen/sdk-snippets-v0.20.0
# will open PR against release/branch
```

frank: Changelog: we have three consumer-visible changes. Can someone add the entries and the version bump (0.19.8 -> 0.20.0) before cut? I can merge after CI green.

anya: @frank please drop the changelog PR link once ready. We should freeze copy for marketing by +45m. Also ping release-bot if anything blocks.

sasha: Canary plan: deploy docs to staging-canary (bucket: rdinference-docs-canary), run these probes: 1) homepage load 2) /console deep link 3) search results for "model routing". Probe script:```python
# healthprobe snippet
import requests
urls = ["/", "/console/overview", "/search?q=model+routing"]
for u in urls:
    r = requests.get(f"https://rd-docs-canary.example.com{u}")
    assert r.status_code == 200
```

maria: I'll run the devex smoke after SDK PR merges. If tests fail, I'll revert the snippet mapping.

kevin: PRs I'll open: 1) regen snippets + mapping 2) sdk-version bump in package.json (0.19.8 -> 0.20.0) 3) changelog entry (frank can review). Expecting 3 PRs, small changes.

frank: I'll add changelog draft now. Quick note: keep the language minimal — product copy will expand post-cut.

docbot: CI status update: "staging-docs-build" queued. Will report when build finishes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

anya: Timeline recap: branch cut at T+0 (in ~2h), SDK regen at T+30m, canary deploy T+40m, smoke probes T+45m, freeze marketing copy T+45m, merge changelog + version bumps T+60m. If any step slips, call it out here.

kevin: One question — do we need to regenerate language bindings or just TS/py snippets? I only planned TS+py.

maria: Devex only requires TS and python for the smoke harness. If we have extra time we can regen go later.

anya: OK TS + py for cutover. Add a TODO in the PR for go regen.

sasha: FYI: search indexing on the docs site runs every 10m. I'll trigger a manual reindex after canary passes.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan created: deploy/docs-canary -> rdinference-docs-canary. Estimated time 3m.

kevin: Pushing PRs in ~20m for pre-checks. If anyone wants to review early ping me. :eyes:

frank: If CI green, I can merge changelog + bump and tag v0.20.0. After merge, can we gate the public docs deploy until post-release window?

anya: Yes gate public deploy. Canary first, then manual approval for public. I'll hold the approval.

maria: I'll be on-call for CI issues during cut. Add me to the PR reviewers.

kevin: Done — added maria + sasha as reviewers on all three PRs.

sasha: I'll kick off the canary deploy when regen PR merges and artifacts published.

docbot: "staging-docs-build" succeeded. artifacts: site/snippets/ updated. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Great — opening PRs now.

anya: Thanks team. If anything unexpected: escalate in #eng-oncall or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
